subject: [PATCH 04/10] mm/madvise: use the PMD softleaf validity helper

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Approved the patch and suggested it's a good use of softleaf. Provided a Reviewed-by tag.
